description:
Banyan Software is the best permanent home for software businesses that serve specialized industries, their employees, and their customers. With a buy-grow-and-hold-for-life approach and a permanent capital base, Banyan acquires and grows companies worldwide, honoring founder legacies and helping portfolio companies modernize through shared AI expertise and operational discipline. Founded in 2016, Banyan operates more than 120 portfolio companies across North and South America, Europe, and APAC, and has appeared on the Inc. 5000 list for six consecutive years. The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world.

About Banyan Software

Banyan Software is the best permanent home for software businesses that serve specialized industries, their employees, and their customers. We are on a mission to acquire, build, and grow great companies worldwide, helping them modernize through shared AI expertise and operational discipline. The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world. Banyan is Great Place to Work Certified, a five-time Inc. 5000 honoree, and a top 10 company on the Deloitte Technology Fast 500. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Atlanta, Banyan operates more than 100 portfolio companies across North America, the UK, EU, and APAC.

About HMM Deutschland GmbH

HMM Deutschland GmbH is a specialist healthcare workflow processor headquartered in NRW, Germany, serving major German statutory health insurers (GKV). The company manages high-volume claims processing and pharmaceutical billing workflows for leading GKV customers — providing mission-critical infrastructure for the German statutory health system with deeply embedded, long-term customer relationships.

Having recently joined the Banyan Software family, the business is entering an exciting new chapter — applying AI-driven process automation to strengthen operational excellence while deepening long-standing customer partnerships.

The Role

We are hiring a Director of Customer Operations & Projects (m/w/d) to own the entire customer delivery layer of the business. This is a senior leadership role at the heart of operations: you will run the project management function, govern BPO and SLA operations across all service lines, and serve as the senior relationship owner for the company's most strategically important accounts.

This role is central to the company's value creation plan under Banyan. You will lead the business through a consequential AI-driven operational transformation while protecting the customer trust and SLA performance that define its market position. You will report directly to the CEO, partner closely with the CPTO on technology delivery, and work with Banyan's DACH Operating Partner on strategic priorities.

What You Will Own

Leadership & Team

  • Reset and professionalise the delivery function — establish clear standards, accountabilities, and operating rhythms across the customer operations and project management teams
  • Organise the team around key customer programmes and strategic projects; ensure every initiative has clear ownership, milestones, and governance from day one
  • Build a high-performing, cohesive team: hire well, develop talent, set expectations clearly, and address underperformance directly and without delay
  • Create a culture of delivery discipline — where commitments are made carefully, tracked rigorously, and met consistently
  • Coach and develop the next layer of leadership within the PM and customer operations team, building capacity that does not depend on the Director as a bottleneck
  • Lead the team through significant operational change — AI-driven transformation, process redesign, and capability building — with clarity, transparency, and pace

Project Management Function

  • Own the project management methodology end-to-end: governance gates, risk and issue tracking, change control, templates, and lessons learned
  • Lead and develop the PM team; set quality standards and drive consistent delivery discipline across all active customer projects
  • Maintain a live portfolio view of all active projects — status, budget, risk, and milestones — reported to the CEO and Banyan monthly
  • Act as the final internal escalation point for any project rated red or amber; bring structure and momentum where delivery is at risk
  • Partner with the CPTO to integrate AI and technology delivery projects into the customer governance framework
  • Drive adoption and hygiene of the existing toolstack across the team

Key Account — Senior Relationship Ownership

  • Serve as the senior relationship owner for the company's largest and highest-priority customer accounts
  • Own account project plans: milestones, deliverables, resource allocation, change management, and acceptance criteria
  • Chair programme steering committees; maintain live risk registers; escalate blockers to the CEO within 24 hours
  • Ensure contractual SLAs are met every month; manage any miss proactively, not reactively
  • Identify expansion opportunities within key accounts: additional workflow coverage, module adoption, and AI-assisted process enhancements
  • Protect relationship continuity through the company's AI-driven transformation — no surprises, no disruption to service

BPO Operations & SLA Governance

  • Own delivery SLAs across all workflow service lines; track KPIs including tickets per FTE, cost per case, time-to-resolution, first-time-right rate, and touchless processing rate
  • Manage the operations team through an AI-driven headcount restructuring while maintaining throughput and quality throughout the transition
  • Project-manage a major in-house billing capability transition, ensuring customer SLAs are uninterrupted throughout
  • Produce a monthly SLA performance dashboard — RAG-rated, trend-based, corrective actions flagged — for the CEO and Banyan Operating Partner
  • Lead quarterly service reviews with all major customers: own the agenda, the data, and the follow-up actions

title: Staff Engineer - Manufacturing Systems & Reliability (f/m/d)
description:
About The Company

GROPYUS is a technology-based construction company focused on building multi-story residential buildings. Thanks to its prefabricated building system with various design options, industrial offsite construction, and fully digitalized processes, the company manufactures aspirational, sustainable, and affordable homes using timber construction methods. GROPYUS is using scalable construction and manufacturing solutions to tap into a future market, boost Europe's strength in innovation, while also playing a substantial role in improving sustainability.

About the Role

You will be part of a highly collaborative product team working at the core of our manufacturing facility, transforming digital models into physical elements at scale. Product Teams at GROPYUS own what they build, including the underlying infrastructure, build pipelines, automated testing, release and rollout management, monitoring, and support. You will be trusted to solve problems efficiently and effectively, building on top of a solid architecture and operational foundation, and will be encouraged to seek out under-attended topics and assume responsibility for them both within your product area and across product areas.

As a Staff Engineer, you have an impact across multiple teams within your product area. Staff Engineers effectively collaborate with other Staff Engineers and foster a culture of regular exchange and cooperation. Their ability to communicate effectively and take initiative ensures that they not only contribute to the technical success of projects, but also help drive overall growth and innovation within the company by sharing both best practices and failures, and learning from them. With your focus on and experience in SRE / operating large systems, you will drive and spearhead operational excellence within your product area.

What you'll be doing

As a Staff Engineer (f/m/d) on the Production Platform team, you will be responsible for:

  • Designing and building the software at the core of our manufacturing and owning the integrations that connect it to physical machines and vendor systems
  • Leading technical initiatives that ensure software systems are reliable, maintainable, and operationally sound, especially in logistics- and manufacturing-heavy domains
  • Working in a hybrid infrastructure environment (cloud and on-prem), managing complex software deployments at scale
  • Bringing a Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) mindset to monitor, maintain, and improve software uptime, including reliable updates, latency, and efficiency
  • Acting as a bridge between digital product delivery and physical logistics and manufacturing systems, including assessing vendors for integration fitness, owning buy-vs-build decisions, and negotiating API changes with machine and equipment vendors toward usable, maintainable interfaces
  • Mentoring engineers across multiple teams and improving system-wide architecture, a maintainable and sound codebase, and operational excellence incl. incident handling
  • Helping define, monitor, and evolve SLAs/SLOs as well as other important KPIs like e.g. OEE for critical systems

What you bring

  • You are an experienced software engineer with a strong background in Site Reliability Engineering or operations
  • You possess practical experience in all key areas of modern software development, including infrastructure, observability, testing, deployment pipelines incl. quality assurance, and scaling
  • You've operated and supported large-scale software systems in cloud and non-cloud environments (on-premise)
  • You've worked in companies with strong operational cultures, ideally in logistics or manufacturing — understanding the commercial impact of system downtime
  • You're comfortable owning integrations with external systems, and can shape and negotiate vendor or machine APIs toward maintainable, scalable interfaces rather than working around whatever you're handed
  • You have experience mentoring and guiding engineers at various levels
  • You are proficient with most of the following technologies:
    • Kotlin / SpringBoot
    • Kubernetes
    • Linux
    • PostgreSQL
    • TimeFold / Camunda / BPMN / Optimization
    • Python / Bash is a plus
    • OPC-UA / PLC / SPS is a plus
  • You bring Cloud Operations experience
    • Experience with Azure is a bonus
  • You're familiar with monitoring and alerting practices for production systems
  • Experience with defining and working with SLAs/SLOs is a bonus
  • You are willing to travel within Germany for in-person team events as well as visiting our manufacturing location

What we offer

    • Be part of something big: You’re here to make a change? Come on board. At GROPYUS, we are on a mission to re-think an entire industry. Join us in reinventing construction and sustainable, affordable living. 
    • It’s on you: We offer a tremendous amount of ownership and room to make a mark - at all our organization levels. Find your solutions, drive and test them.
    • Focus on results: You choose if you work from home, a park, or the office. Whether you start your day early, after your run, or pick up on work when your kids are in bed. What counts is your contribution and delivery.
    • Bring your uniqueness to the team: Innovation requires diversity of thought. Diversity in background, experience and thinking is crucial to create the best product for everyone. We actively seek diversity and strive to unlock each other’s full potential. We are very proud that people from all industries and all walks of life are joining our company – in addition to core areas such as construction, engineering, and start-ups, from stock-listed companies from across automotive e-Commerce, digital, sporting goods, and more. You will work in international teams with passionate colleagues. Inspire and be inspired.
    • Be an owner: Participate in the success of GROPYUS through stock options.

Join us on our mission to design buildings as continuously evolving products to create the most exciting and affordable experience for all. We build for people and conserve the resources of our planet.

We can't wait to get to know you. 
For more information, visit our website.

title: Senior Security Engineer (m/f/d)
description: Your mission Do you want to do more than just write security concepts - and put your decisions into practice directly? Do you see cloud security not as a compliance checklist, but as the combination of threat modeling, Infrastructure as Code, and genuine hands-on engineering? Then we are looking for you to join our CISO team as a Senior Security Engineer (m/f/d) in a hybrid working model in Munich, Berlin or Halle (Saale) . You will join a three-person team where responsibility is genuinely shared: no ticket queues and no “that’s not my area.” We plan together, cover for one another, and usually implement and operate the security controls we design ourselves. This means you will see the impact of your work immediately - not at some point in the distant future. Your Responsibilities Security Architecture & Cloud Guardrails: You will take technical ownership of the security architecture and controls across our Azure environment - from Defender for Cloud and Microsoft Sentinel to Log Analytics. You will build and maintain the corresponding guardrails directly in Terraform. Detection Engineering: You will develop and continuously improve our detections in close collaboration with our Security Analyst, who is responsible for day-to-day SIEM monitoring and triage. You will work as a well-coordinated team rather than in separate silos. Vulnerability Management: You will further develop our vulnerability management and monitoring across a hybrid environment. This includes our growing cloud landscape as well as the existing on-premises stack for as long as the migration is ongoing. Security Beyond the Cloud: You will contribute your expertise beyond cloud security, including identity, endpoint security, application security, incident response, and AI. Using your security engineering skills, you will, for example, develop tooling for AI-assisted penetration testing within our team and translate it into practical, scalable processes. AI-Assisted Engineering: You will use tools such as Claude Code to build and maintain internal security tools and automations. At the same time, you will help us identify AI-specific risks early—from the secure use of AI coding assistants to prompt injection. Your skillset Azure Security & Certifications: You have at least five years of experience in security engineering and several years of hands-on experience implementing Azure security. You hold an AZ-500 certification or have equivalent practical expertise. SC-100, CISSP, CCSP, or Security+ certifications are a plus. Infrastructure & Automation: You can confidently read, write, and further develop security-related Terraform code. Experience with Python, Django, PowerShell, or AI-assisted development is a plus. Identity & Detection: You have practical experience with Entra ID, RBAC, and PIM, as well as solid knowledge of network security, SIEM, and detection engineering. Offensive Security & Vulnerability Management: Ideally, you have experience with traditional or AI-assisted penetration testing and with tools such as Tenable or Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management. Hands-On Mindset: You do not just design security controls -you implement and operate them in practice. When you identify a problem, you do not wait for a ticket; you take ownership and develop a solution. Collaboration & Communication: You share knowledge and responsibility and work closely with the team on areas of joint ownership. You communicate confidently and professionally in English. title: Buyer Development Sr Director DACH
description: Company at a Glance OpenX is focused on unleashing the full economic potential of digital media companies. We do this by making digital advertising markets and technologies that are designed to deliver optimal value to publishers and advertisers on every ad served across all screens. At OpenX, we have built a team that is uniquely experienced in designing and operating high-scale ad marketplaces, and we are constantly on the lookout for thoughtful, creative executors who are as fascinated as we are about finding new ways to apply a blend of market design, technical innovation, operational excellence, and empathetic partner service to the frontiers of digital advertising. OpenX is looking for a senior, commercially driven Buyer Development leader to establish and grow our demand-side business across DACH. This is the first dedicated Buyer Development role in-market. The role will be directly responsible for generating revenue across agencies, holdcos, and clients / brands, building senior relationships and commercial foundations required for long-term growth. The successful candidate will open senior buyer relationships, build and manage pipeline, progress strategic opportunities, and convert demand-side engagement into measurable revenue outcomes. This is a senior individual contributor role to begin with. As the DACH opportunity matures, the ambition is for this person to help build and potentially lead a broader regional Buyer Development function once clear market proof points have been established. Key Responsibilities: Own Revenue Growth Take direct responsibility for generating and growing buyer-led revenue across agencies, holdcos, and clients / brands in DACH. Build and manage a qualified pipeline across PMP, curation, SPO, CTV, data-led activation, OpenX Select, premium supply, AI-led solutions, and direct buyer partnerships. Convert senior relationships into commercial outcomes through consultative selling, strategic account planning, business cases, QBRs, joint business plans, and deal progression. Maintain strong commercial discipline around pipeline, forecasting, revenue progression, and opportunity prioritisation. Build the Market Establish OpenX’s Buyer Development presence in DACH as the first dedicated in-market hire. Create a clear map of priority buyers, agencies, holdcos, brands, DSPs, data partners, senior decision-makers, trading models, and commercial pathways. Identify where OpenX can create the most meaningful and scalable impact in the region. Build the foundations for a future regional team, including account prioritisation, pipeline discipline, market feedback loops, and cross-functional ways of working. Work Cross-Functionally Work closely with Sales, Account Management, Product, Marketing, global Buyer Development, DSP Strategic Partnerships, and the Data Partner function to shape, activate, measure, and scale DACH opportunities. Partner with DSP Strategic Partnerships to improve buyer access, support SPO conversations, and ensure agency and client demand can be activated efficiently through priority DSP routes. Partner with the Data Partner function to identify relevant data-led opportunities for DACH buyers, including curated marketplaces, audience-led activation, and strategic client solutions. Build OpenX’s Market Presence Represent OpenX as a credible senior voice in the DACH programmatic market. Support OpenX’s visibility through senior meetings, client education, industry events, roundtables, and thought leadership. Position OpenX around key buyer priorities including transparency, sustainability, premium supply, curation, data quality, supply path optimisation, and a healthier digital advertising ecosystem. Requirements: 7+ years of experience as a senior commercial individual contributor with deep knowledge of the DACH programmatic advertising ecosystem and a strong network across agencies, holdcos, brands, DSPs, and strategic partners. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of revenue ownership, opening senior relationships, building pipeline, and converting strategic opportunities into commercial outcomes. They should be credible with senior clients and partners, highly self-motivated, commercially disciplined, and comfortable building a market from an early-stage position. Fluency in German and English is required. OpenX VALUES Our five company values form a solid bedrock serving to define us as a group and guide the company. Our values remind us that how we do things often matters as much as what we do. WE ARE ONE We are one team. There are no exceptions. We are a group of strong and diverse individuals unified by a shared mission. We embrace challenges and win together as a team. We respect and care about our colleagues and cultivate an inclusive culture WE ARE CUSTOMER CENTRIC We innovate on behalf of our customers. We understand, respect, and listen carefully to our customers. We build great products to solve our customers’ problems. We manage our customers’ expectations clearly and honestly. We are a trusted partner to all of our customers - we act with integrity at all times. We care. OPENX IS OURS We are all owners of OpenX We all have a voice to improve OpenX We stake our personal and professional reputations on the excellence of our work We are not interested in just "doing our jobs"; we take ownership to drive results WE ARE AN OPEN BOOK We understand and respect what each of us does. We are eager to teach and share what we know with others, both internally and externally. We are eager to learn from others and we ask questions internally and externally. WE EVOLVE FAST We take responsible risks and own and learn from our mistakes. We recognize and repeat success. We actively seek out and provide constructive feedback. We adapt quickly and embrace change. We tackle growth and learning with real urgency. We are endlessly curious. OpenX TRAITS Our three traits capture what makes a great team member at OpenX. HUMBLE Ideal team players are humble and demonstrate integrity. They put the team's success above their own, share credit generously, and value collective achievements. They are self-assured, open to coaching, and committed to continuous learning. DRIVEN Ideal team players are results-driven and motivated. They are curious, always seeking more to do, learn, and take on. As proactive problem-solvers, they take initiative without needing external motivation. They continuously think about the next steps and opportunities for improvement. SMART Ideal team players are smart and possess the intellectual acumen to understand the complexities of our organization and industry. They are interpersonally intelligent, good communicators, and exemplify sound judgment in their interactions across the company to foster a collaborative environment. OpenX is committed to equal employment opportunities. description: Forschung im Mittelstand scheitert selten daran, dass die Ideen ausgehen. Sie endet dann, wenn das Budget ausgeht. Sie kalkulieren es, formulieren es und bringen es durch die Prüfstelle. Das Mandat gehört Ihnen, die fachliche Entscheidung auch. Genau dafür gibt es fundloop. Wir unterstützen mittelständische Unternehmen dabei, ihre Forschung und Entwicklung über die steuerliche Forschungszulage zu finanzieren, und haben dafür eine eigene Software gebaut, die Ihnen bei dieser Arbeit den Rücken freihält. Sie arbeiten zu 100 Prozent remote, ohne Beratungsapparat über sich und mit direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung. Aufgaben Sie beraten Unternehmen bei der inhaltlichen Ausgestaltung und Strukturierung ihrer Förderprojekte in Forschung, Entwicklung und Innovation. Im Einzelnen heißt das: Förderprojekte formen: Aus dem, was ein Unternehmen tatsächlich entwickelt, schneiden Sie ein sauber abgegrenztes Vorhaben zu - Technische Neuheit, wissenschaftliche und technische Unsicherheit und Arbeitspakete. Fachlich bewerten: Sie beurteilen früh, ob ein Vorhaben förderfähig ist. Auch dann, wenn die Antwort Nein lautet. Projektkosten selbstständig prüfen und kalkulieren: Personalaufwand, Auftragsforschung und Eigenleistungen, plausibel hergeleitet und GoBD-konform dokumentiert, mit Blick auf eine spätere Betriebsprüfung. Mit der Prüfstelle kommunizieren: Sie führen den Austausch mit der Bescheinigungsstelle Forschungszulage in Stufe 1 und beantworten deren Rückfragen. Die steuerliche Einreichung in Stufe 2 verantwortet der Steuerberater des Mandanten, mit dem Sie eng zusammenarbeiten. Mandate führen: Kickoff, Interviews mit Entwicklern und Technikern, Unterlagen einsammeln, Termine halten. Qualifikation Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Naturwissenschaften, Technik oder Wirtschaft. Location: Smart parc, Spondon, Derby DE21 7HW

Shift Pattern: Suez Shift Pattern rotating days and nights, 0600-1800 and 1800-0600.

● 70% off HelloFresh or Green Chef boxes

● Mental health first aiders and an employee assistance programme

● Cycle to work scheme

Play a key part in supporting our Employee Resource Groups: FreshVets, Black Heritage Network, NEU Network (Neurodiversity), GET (Gender Equality Team) and FreshPride

About the job:

This role is responsible for ensuring the maintenance, repairs, and improvements of both automated and non-automated systems on-site. The Reliability Engineer will work to ensure maximum uptime and reliability of equipment while actively participating in both preventive and reactive maintenance tasks. This role will also support automation systems, including conveyance and facilities equipment.

  • Hands-On System Monitoring & Repair: Actively monitor, troubleshoot, and repair systems to provide a high level of equipment availability.
  • Preventive Maintenance & Inspections: Perform routine maintenance on automation, robotics, and control panels.
  • Troubleshooting & Escalation: Diagnose and address issues in out-of-service equipment; escalate complex issues as necessary.
  • Documentation: Record all work in the Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) and ticketing systems as appropriate.
  • Contractor Collaboration: Work with contractors to ensure projects are completed to specification, addressing performance issues as needed.
  • Project & Ad Hoc Engineering Tasks: Participate in cross-functional projects as required.
  • Predictive & Preventative Maintenance: Engage in predictive maintenance activities to maintain machine uptime for operational needs.
  • Training & Mentorship: Provide training and mentorship to Junior Engineers on reliability practices and techniques.
  • Health & Safety Compliance: Adhere to and support food safety and health & safety standards.
  • Root Cause Analysis: Participate in Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for continuous improvement.

Who You Are:

  • Hold a degree in computer science, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, or a related field would be advantageous. 
  • Skilled in material handling, flow and capacity visualisation, and monitoring.
  • Proficient in PLC-controlled automation and issue diagnosis in continuous production environments.
  • Extensive experience with PLCs, HMIs, VFDs, including programming, troubleshooting, and maintenance.
  • Advanced understanding of PLCs and automated processes.
  • Analytical Skills: Strong problem-solving abilities for technical issues in automation systems.
  • Project Management: Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise tasks, manage timelines, and deliver results within budget.

Next steps: Your application will be reviewed and if successful, a member of the Talent Acquisition Team will be in touch within 2 weeks.

You are required to cooperate with HelloFresh in all health and safety matters. You are responsible for ensuring you take reasonable care of your own health, and safety as well as others who may be affected by the work activities you undertake. You must report incidents immediately and actively raise health and safety-related concerns to your Line Manager. As part of our commitment to maintaining a safe and secure environment, we will process Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) checks to the successful individual. Failure to disclose relevant information at application or throughout the process could affect your employment with the company. 

If you are currently a HelloFresh employee, please make sure you have discussed your application with your Line Manager.

To be considered for this role, you’ll need to have the independent right to work in the UK, as we're unfortunately unable to provide sponsorship at this time.

SIMPL Business Unit — Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS)

Seyond

Location: Germany preferred (open to strong candidates elsewhere in Europe)

Reports to: Philip Lassner, Head of Global ITS Business (ex-US/China)

Team: SIMPL Business Unit — LiDAR-based smart intersection and highway detection

Employment type: Full-time

About Seyond SIMPL

SIMPL is scaling its international footprint across Europe, APAC, and emerging markets, and is building out dedicated regional sales leadership to match the growth already underway in the Americas.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Director of Sales to build and lead SIMPL's sales function across Europe — a role modeled on the regional sales leadership Seyond has already established in the Americas. You will report directly to Philip Lassner, Head of Global ITS Business, and will sit above SIMPL's country-level sales representatives across Europe, giving the region a single accountable sales leader for the first time.

This is a player-coach role. We need someone who has personally carried and exceeded a sales quota — not a candidate whose background is purely sales operations or account management — and who can also recruit, coach, and manage a small, distributed team of regional reps as the European organization scales.

What You'll Do

  • Build and lead SIMPL's European sales organization, recruiting, onboarding, and coaching country and regional sales representatives.
  • Personally own and close strategic opportunities while the regional team is being built out, transitioning toward a team-quota model as the organization scales.
  • Develop and execute go-to-market strategy across both SIMPL verticals: urban intersection management and inter-urban highway/tunnel/tolling detection.
  • Manage and grow relationships with European distributors, system integrators, and OEM partners, alongside direct engagement with end-user agencies and pilot customers.
  • Own the European sales pipeline and forecast in HubSpot, maintaining accurate deal ownership, stage progression, and close-date discipline.
  • Represent SIMPL at European trade shows, industry events, and customer meetings.
  • Partner with SIMPL's European engineering team on technical qualification and solution scoping for major opportunities.
  • Collaborate with the Head of Global ITS Business and BU leadership on regional pricing, deal structuring, and strategic account planning.
  • Establish clear rep-level KPIs that balance new-business generation with existing-account growth, supported by weekly activity tracking.

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years of B2B sales experience, ideally in ITS, smart infrastructure, industrial IoT/sensors, or another technical, tender-driven market.
  • A proven personal quota-carrying track record as an individual contributor — a genuine "hunter," not primarily an account manager or sales-ops leader.
  • Experience building or leading a distributed regional sales team, ideally spanning multiple European countries.
  • Comfort managing both channel relationships (distributors, OEMs, system integrators) and direct end-user/agency sales cycles.
  • Experience navigating public-sector or government tender processes is a strong plus.
  • Fluent English required; German or another major European language is a plus.
  • Willingness to travel extensively across Europe.

Nice to Have

  • An existing network in European traffic management, tolling, or highway agencies.
  • Experience selling LiDAR, radar, or other sensor-based detection technologies.
  • Familiarity with HubSpot or a comparable CRM.

Compensation

Competitive base and incentive package, benchmarked to Director-level sales leadership roles in the European technology/industrial sector. Final compensation band to be confirmed following market benchmarking.

About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo
  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

The Team You'll Join

You'll be part of our Mirakl Connect Engineering team lead by Jean-Yves Cazac, Engineering Director. The team consists of approximately 50 engineers covering the full Mirakl Connect product scope, from seller onboarding and experience to marketplace integrations and channel management. Together, you'll be shaping how sellers and brands connect, operate, and grow across multiple marketplaces worldwide.

In this role, you will directly lead 2 squads — Seller Experience and Channel Integration — representing approximately 12 engineers based between Paris, & Bordeaux, with close collaboration with colleagues based in the US.

Location: Based in Paris or Bordeaux office with one day of remote work per week.

 

Your Impact

  • Lead and develop two engineering squads responsible for the seller journey on Mirakl Connect and integrations with external marketplaces such as Amazon, Walmart, and Zalando, ensuring reliable delivery and a high engineering bar across both teams.
  • Partner closely with Product and Design to define priorities, translate business needs into execution plans, and make trade-offs that balance delivery speed, quality, and technical sustainability.
  • Drive the technical direction of your scope — challenging architectural choices, ensuring solutions are scalable and maintainable, and raising best practices in testing, observability, and incident management.
  • Develop your people: coach engineers and tech leads, identify growth opportunities, run performance and career conversations, and contribute to attracting strong talent into the organization.
  • Build a strong operating model for your teams — improving ways of working pragmatically, protecting team focus, fostering ownership, and enabling effective collaboration with distributed and international stakeholders.

 

What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:

  • At least 4 to 5 years of experience managing engineering teams, with a track record of leading teams of 5 to 6 engineers or more, ideally across multiple squads.
  • Proven experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, channel management, feed management, catalog or order management — or a closely related domain.
  • A solid Java background — you may no longer be hands-on today, but you have the depth to challenge architectural decisions, assess technical trade-offs, and manage a team of Java engineers with credibility.
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver in a demanding and fast-moving environment, while protecting team focus and adapting your management approach to the existing context.
  • Experience collaborating with international and cross-functional stakeholders across time zones.

Skills:

  • Engineering leadership: ability to set direction, delegate effectively, and develop people at all levels.
  • Execution in complexity: capable of managing delivery, priorities, and trade-offs across multiple teams simultaneously.
  • Technical judgment: able to engage in Java architecture discussions, challenge integration design choices, and guide engineers on complex distributed systems.
  • Fluent English: able to lead discussions, challenge decisions, and collaborate autonomously with US-based and international partners.

 

Tech Stack

  • Java (recent versions)
  • Spring Framework
  • SQL
  • Cloud platforms
  • Microservices architecture

 

Languages

  • French: Full professional proficiency
  • English mandatory: Full professional proficiency — approximately 50% of your working time will be in English

 

Our Hiring Process

We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match.
Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application — this helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.

  1. 30/45 min call with a Talent Acquisition to discuss your key projects, ask technical questions, and present the position in details
  2. 1 hour Hiring Manager interview 
  3. 2x45 min STAR interviews to assess your alignment with our values and meet other stakeholders

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

Built on top of Supabase Edge Runtime: an open-source, Deno-based runtime written in Rust that runs JavaScript, TypeScript, and WASM services.

We want developers to be able to build truly global applications by distributing both compute and data globally. Infrastructure concerns like regions, cold starts, CPU and memory provisioning should fade into the background so developers can focus on iterating on business logic.

We are looking for experienced and passionate engineers to help us go further in this vision.

What You’ll Own

  • Evolving Supabase Edge Runtime - an Open-sourced Rust-based host that runs the Deno isolate, manages the main/user runtime split, and enforces per-request memory and CPU limits.

  • Implementing monitoring, alerting, and OpenTelemetry tracing across the runtime, then using that visibility to drive optimizations that improve latency and reliability of the service.

  • Working closely with the Deno and other open-source teams, contributing to upstream and relaying our users' requirements.

  • Participating in an on-call rotation to keep Edge Functions healthy in production.

  • Help manage and improve features like scheduled functions, background tasks, WebSockets streaming, ephemeral file storage, and custom routing.

  • Integrating functions more tightly with the rest of the Supabase stack - Auth, Postgres, Storage, and Realtime.

  • Expanding functions to support more use cases (AI inference, MCP servers, hosting simple websites, URL shorteners).

  • Improving the DX of developing and debugging functions locally through the Supabase CLI, including DevTools integration, logging, and production parity.

What You’ll Bring

  • At least 5 years of backend or systems engineering experience, with strong fluency in Rust and TypeScript.

  • Experience with V8 Isolates, Deno and the JavaScript runtimes in general.

  • Experience operating infrastructure at scale - Kubernetes, AWS, Cloudflare Workers, Redis, or comparable systems.

  • A strong vision for how compute and data can be pushed to the edge.

  • Bonus: experience building developer-facing CLIs or front-end tooling that sits on top of an infrastructure product.

What We Offer

  • Fully Remote

    We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

  • ESOP

    Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

  • Tech Allowance

    Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

  • Health Benefits

    Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

  • Annual Off-Sites

    Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

  • Flexible Work

    We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

  • Professional Development

    Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

  • ~400 team members

  • 60+ countries

  • 20+ languages spoken

  • Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

  • 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

Role Purpose

The Forward Deployed Engineer works directly with enterprise clients to design, deploy, and optimise GenAI data solutions, with full ownership of final delivered data quality. Embedded across engineering, data operations, and client delivery, this role ensures datasets, pipelines, workflows, and automations meet defined accuracy, reliability, and performance requirements for GenAI model development.

Your Impact

  • Act as a trusted consultative partner to clients by defining requirements, clarifying success criteria, shaping high‑quality annotation guidelines, and proactively providing insights and innovative solutions that strengthen trust and improve data quality, efficiency, and model outcomes.
  • Influence the what and the why behind GenAI data solutions by translating ambiguous client needs into clear, scalable workflows.
  • Deliver zero-defect GenAI datasets that meet all defined acceptance and quality criteria.
  • Build scalable, reproducible, and observable validation and automation pipelines that reduce variance, manual review effort, rework, and time to validation.
  • Contribute reusable quality frameworks and validators adopted across multiple projects.

What you Bring

  • Experience working on GenAI, machine learning, or model evaluation data.
  • A consultative problem-solving approach when leading client conversations, asking sharp questions, and guiding stakeholders toward better decisions.
  • Hands-on experience designing and implementing data pipelines, validation systems, or workflow automation.
  • Previous experience in owning final data quality and acting as the authority on delivery readiness.
  • The ability to translate business or model development needs technical workflows and validation logic.
  • Confidence in working directly with client engineering or machine learning teams.
  • Strong documentation that prioritizes reproducibility, observability, and reliability.

Compensation

Additional Information

Why You’ll Love Working Here

At Appen, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence. We value curiosity, accountability, and a commitment to delivering the highest-quality AI solutions for frontier models.

You’ll work on complex challenges that shape the future of AI across industries and geographies, alongside talented people in a culture that values humility over ego. raw.title: Cloud and AI Engineer
raw.description:
About CHAPTERS Group

CHAPTERS Group AG is a Hamburg-based holding company investing in 55+ mission-critical software companies across the DACH region, France, and the Czech Republic. Our companies deliver the digital solutions that keep the public sector and core industries running. What they do matters in daily life.

AI has rapidly disrupted the software industry, and we aim to lead that transformation across our portfolio. Central to this is the AI Core team: we build and operate a shared enterprise AI Hub used by companies across the group, and drive adoption through a network of AI Champions. Each portfolio company has one designated power user who leads AI enablement locally, runs training, and scales usage within their organisation.

Tasks

The Role

You are a core member of the AI Core team, owning the infrastructure that powers AI adoption across 55+ portfolio companies. Your focus is the AI Hub platform (Open WebUI): you keep it running, deploy new instances, build and validate integrations at HQ level, and make sure every company in the group gets a stable, well-configured environment.

We build the AI Hub as a product and support to ship it in every company. Each company owns their HUB and administers it (L1 Support). You are part of the central team that drives features and changes that are of high value for all hubs in the portfolio.

In addition, you are part of the team that serves as the center of expertise (L2 Support) and give guidance and hands-on support when the first level teams need you.

What You Will Work On

  • Platform engineering: new integrations, container images, infrastructure-as-code, deployment tooling and security patches. This is the product that every company runs
  • Release qualification: when the upstream project ships a new version, you assess it (one-way database migrations, breaking changes, patch compatibility), validate it on a canary, and publish a qualified release with notes that an L1 can act on
  • Shared infrastructure: Application Gateway, WAF policies, TLS certificates, Redis, DNS and network peering. This layer is shared across every company and cannot be devolved. A mistake here affects all of them
  • Enable the L1 network and be their technical point of contact: write the developer guides, run onboarding and office hours, and build preflight checks and guardrails that make it safe for a platform admin to deploy and operate their own Hub.
  • Integrations Catalog stewardship: versioned artefacts (tools, skills, agents, integrations) each shipped with a user guide for AI Champions and a developer guide for platform admins
  • Fleet observability: reporting and alerting version parity, uptime, cloud spend and deployment status across all companies.
  • Own the eval service: the service itself, the quality of judges and generators, and the methodology platforms use to measure whether their agents do the work
  • Close the loop. Shipping is the beginning. Your designs gather operational signals from the fleet and feed a continuous improvement cycle

Requirements

What We Are Looking For

Required

  • At least 2 years of professional experience in platform engineering, DevOps, SRE, or cloud operations, including ownership of production systems that others depend on
  • Production cloud experience on Azure or AWS
  • Infrastructure as Code in production: Bicep, Terraform, CDK or CloudFormation. We care that you think in IaC.
  • Strong Python skills beyond scripting: you have built and maintained small production services, worked with APIs, and found your way around unfamiliar codebases
  • Comfortable with Linux, Docker, Git and CI/CD as everyday working tools
  • Working knowledge of databases and identity: PostgreSQL in production, and OAuth / SSO / Entra ID concepts
  • AI-native: you use LLMs as tools, understand their operational properties, and have shipped something with them
  • English (fluent): primary working language across the team; German conversational is a plus

Bonus

  • Clear technical writing: Enabling others is a real part of this role and good documentation is part of the work rather than an afterthought
  • Experience building internal platforms or tooling used by other engineering teams
  • Working in multi-tenant or multi-customer cloud environments
  • Contributions to open-source projects, or maintaining a modified version of one in production
  • Practical experience with LLM frameworks, agents, MCP or RAG systems in production
  • French language skills: a share of our portfolio is in France and growing

Benefits

What You'll Get

  • A role that shapes the AI backbone for more than 50 software companies across Europe.
  • Become part of CHAPTERS Group, a German serial acquirer with 10x growth in the past five years and high ambitions for what comes next
  • A small, high-ownership team: decisions get made fast, your work ships to production. You are part of the CTO office with a direct line to the leadership team
  • Daily work with cutting-edge AI technologies.
  • Space to define how AI gets integrated into operational business systems at group scale: early-stage work with lasting impact across 55+ companies
  • Permanent full-time position, remote-first with the option to join the team in the Cologne office
  • A clear path to grow with us: we look for ambitious people who want to build a career, not just take a role. We actively invest in your development: talent reviews, events, conferences, etc.

How to Apply

Send your CV and answer the following questions, no formal cover letter needed:

  • Why do you find it exciting to work with vertical market software companies?
  • Why are you the right person to drive AI in the CHAPTERS Group? What is your “unfair advantage”?

We are looking forward to your application!

title: Executive Assistant (m/w/d) für den CEO
description: Unser Mandant ist ein führender Anbieter von Dienstleistungen zur Instandhaltung unterirdischer Infrastruktur in Nordeuropa mit europaweiter Marktpräsenz. Die deutsche Niederlassung beschäftigt ca. 800 Mitarbeitende und erzielt einen Umsatz von rund 100 Millionen Euro jährlich. Die Organisation wächst dynamisch durch Akquisitionen und entwickelt ihre Strukturen, Prozesse und zentralen Funktionen kontinuierlich weiter. Die Zusammenarbeit ist direkt, pragmatisch, bodenständig und respektvoll. Für den CEO der deutschen Landesgesellschaft suchen wir eine unternehmerisch denkende und umsetzungsstarke Persönlichkeit als Executive Assistant (m/w/d). Aufgaben Als Executive Assistant (m/w/d) sind Sie die organisatorische Schaltzentrale der deutschen Holding. Sie halten dem CEO den Rücken frei, schaffen Struktur in einem dynamischen Umfeld und sorgen dafür, dass aus Entscheidungen konkrete Ergebnisse werden. Sie organisieren und priorisieren den anspruchsvollen Kalender des CEO und koordinieren Termine, Meetings, Geschäftsreisen und Veranstaltungen. Sie strukturieren Themen, Entscheidungen und offene Punkte, bereiten Besprechungen vor und verfolgen die Umsetzung konsequent nach. Sie erstellen Präsentationen, Auswertungen, Entscheidungsvorlagen und weitere Managementunterlagen. Sie koordinieren die Zusammenarbeit mit dem CFO, COO, den Geschäftsführungen der Beteiligungsunternehmen, externen Dienstleistern und weiteren Stakeholdern. Sie übernehmen vielfältige Sonderprojekte, unter anderem in den Bereichen Post-Merger-Integration, HR, Einkauf sowie Messen und Veranstaltungen und wirken beim Aufbau von Strukturen sowie Prozessen mit. Qualifikation Sie verfügen über eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation und bringen mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in einer eigenständigen Assistenz-, Operations-, Projektmanagement- oder kaufmännischen Schnittstellenfunktion mit. Sie organisieren sich und andere sehr strukturiert, setzen klare Prioritäten und behalten auch bei einer hohen Themenvielfalt den Überblick. Sie treiben Aufgaben eigenständig voran, bleiben verbindlich am Ball und bringen Themen konsequent bis zum Abschluss. Sie besitzen ein breites kaufmännisches Grundverständnis, denken unternehmerisch und können wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge einschätzen. Sie kommunizieren sicher auf Deutsch und auf Englisch (B2) sowie souverän, verbindlich und adressatengerecht mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern. Sie arbeiten sicher mit den gängigen Microsoft 365 Produkten, treten diskret und vertrauenswürdig auf und bringen die Bereitschaft zu regelmäßigen Dienstreisen mit. Benefits Großer Gestaltungsspielraum: Sie bauen Strukturen aktiv mit auf und gestalten die Zukunft der deutschen Holding. Sichtbare Wirkung: Als zentrale Vertrauensperson des CEO bewegen Sie Themen und schaffen konkrete Ergebnisse. Attraktives Paket mit Feingehalt, Firmenwagen und 30 Urlaubstage bei einer 40-Stunden-Woche. Flexibles Arbeiten: Mobiles Arbeiten und kurze Entscheidungswege in einer direkten, pragmatischen Unternehmenskultur. Zukunftssichere Perspektive: Sie arbeiten in einer krisenfesten, wachstumsstarken Branche mit langfristig stabilem Bedarf und sicheren Zukunftsperspektiven. Sie möchten als Executive Assistant nicht nur organisieren, sondern in einem gesund wachsenden Unternehmen Verantwortung übernehmen, Themen vorantreiben und sichtbare Ergebnisse schaffen? Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung: Ihr Lebenslauf genügt. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Associate Director International Procurement
description:
The role

As an Associate Director, Procurement, you will report to the Procurement Director and own the strategy, performance, and people development for your category cluster. This is a 12-month fixed-term position. You will lead a team of Category Managers, set the direction for supplier relationships and commercial outcomes, and operate as the senior point of escalation across operational and strategic procurement challenges.

This is a role for a procurement professional who is equally comfortable in a negotiation room with a strategic supplier, a governance forum with senior cross-functional leaders, and a development conversation with a direct report. You will act as a connector between your team's day-to-day work and the broader supply chain strategy and as a builder of capability, process, and relationships that outlast the current planning cycle.

 

What you’ll do

Strategy & Category Leadership

  • Define and own the multi-year category strategy for your cluster sourcing model, supplier segmentation, risk posture, and cost ambition and present that strategy coherently to Director-level stakeholders.
  • Translate market intelligence (commodity dynamics, seasonality, geopolitical risk, supply constraints) into actionable procurement decisions and communicate them with clarity and confidence.
  • Lead cross-category standardization and process improvement initiatives, identifying leverage across the broader portfolio where applicable.

Supplier Relationships & Partnerships

  • Build and steward the most strategically important supplier relationships in your cluster, including joint investment plans, multi-year contracts, and structured partnership governance.
  • Lead or oversee tender processes end-to-end — from strategy and data-pack through to award, contract, and supplier briefing at pace and to a high standard of documentation.
  • Act as the senior escalation point for supply disruptions, quality issues, and commercial disputes, resolving with a mix of supplier accountability and operational pragmatism.
  • Develop new or alternative suppliers to strengthen resilience and competitiveness across your category network.

Performance, Data & Commercial Delivery

  • Take full commercial accountability for your cluster's cost performance, savings targets, and COGS variance — ensuring outcomes are tracked, explained, and acted upon.
  • Drive a data-first culture within your team: category reviews, investment cases, and supplier performance assessments should be grounded in robust analysis and structured decision-making.
  • Contribute to seasonality planning, static pricing rounds, and volume S&OP processes with the rigour and cross-functional coordination those forums require.
  • Oversee cost reporting, invoice validation and supplier database quality for your cluster.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead, coach and develop a team of Category Managers, creating a high-performance environment that is psychologically safe, commercially ambitious, and genuinely invested in its people.
  • Shift progressively from doing to enabling: your job is to build the capability of your team, not to be their best individual contributor.
  • Own team capacity planning, workload prioritization, and performance development including calibration, promotion cases, and succession thinking.
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement, clear communication, and accountability without micromanagement.

Stakeholder & Cross-functional Leadership

  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with Product, Supply Chain Operations, FSQA, Finance, and Legal representing Procurement credibly and influencing decisions in cross-functional forums.
  • Represent GRO Strategic Procurement at Director-level planning and governance meetings as appropriate, contributing with the strategic perspective expected at that level.
  • Manage upward effectively — keeping the Procurement Director informed, flagging risks early, and bringing well-framed recommendations rather than unresolved problems.

 

What you’ll bring

Experience

  • 7+/9+ years in strategic procurement, supply chain, or a closely related commercial discipline ideally in FMCG, or food ingredients, though we care more about the quality of thinking than the specific category.
  • Demonstrated track record of building supplier relationships at a strategic level, including contract negotiation, partnership governance, and managing through disruption.
  • Experience setting and executing category strategy across a meaningful portfolio ideally managing a cluster of subcategories or a team.
  • Proven ability to lead and develop others, whether as a formal team lead or through mentoring, cross-functional project leadership, or stepping up in an interim capacity.

Skills & Mindset

  • Strategically confident: you can connect day-to-day procurement decisions to a longer-term commercial and supply chain vision, and you communicate that narrative clearly to senior audiences.
  • Data-driven: comfortable building investment cases, analyzing COGS variance, and driving evidence-based decision-making within your team.
  • A natural relationship-builder inside the business and with suppliers who can hold a firm commercial position while maintaining the trust and goodwill the relationship depends on.
  • Coach rather than doer: you instinctively look to develop the person next to you rather than solve the problem yourself.
  • Operationally resilient: you stay focused and solution-oriented in a fast-paced, supply-volatile environment, and you bring that steadiness to your team.
  • Proactive and accountable you take ownership, raise risks early, and bring solutions rather than problems.

 

What we offer

Elevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.

  • Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.
  • Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh- subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.
  • Elevate your lifestyle with exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.
  • Invest in your growth with an annual learning & development budget, German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.
  • Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access, wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!

title: Senior Performance Marketing Manager – Performance Marketing, MMM & AI (m/w/d)
description: Du hast den kompletten Performance-Marketing-Mix fest im Griff und nutzt KI im Kampagnenmanagement nicht als Hype, sondern als tägliches Werkzeug? Du möchtest datengetriebene Entscheidungen zur Budgetallokation treffen und aktiv mitgestalten, wie modernste AI-Tools die Steuerung im E-Commerce revolutionieren? Dann wartet in unserem Team in Berlin deine nächste große Challenge auf dich: Bei benuta übernimmst du echte Ownership über unsere Kanäle hinweg und treibst ein echtes Greenfield-Thema voran – die Skalierung KI-gestützter Analysen und Strategien für den europäischen Marktführer im Home-&-Living-Bereich! Deine Aufgaben Strategische Kanal- & Budgetsteuerung: Du entwickelst und verantwortest die kanalübergreifende Performance-Marketing-Strategie via MMM zur Erreichung unserer Unternehmensziele (Umsatz, Effizienz, Lead-Gen, Brand Awareness). Du steuerst und optimierst Kampagnen über Google Ads, Bing Ads, Meta, Pinterest, Reddit Ads sowie Affiliate-Partnerschaften mit einer konsistenten Budget- und Ziellogik. AI-Integration & Workflow-Innovation: Du treibst den Einsatz von LLMs (z. B. Claude, Gemini) für die automatisierte, kanalübergreifende Analyse unserer Kampagnendaten aktiv voran. Du entwickelst Prompts und Workflows für beschleunigtes Reporting, Anomalie-Erkennung sowie Budget-Optimierungen und agierst als interner Expert für KI-gestützte Marketing-Tools. Analyse & Bidding-Evaluierung: Du überwachst und analysierst alle relevanten KPIs (CPO, ROAS, CAC, Conversion Rate) auf Basis von GA4 und unserem serverseitigen Tracking-Setup (server-side GTM). Zudem bewertest du KI-gestützte Bidding- und Automatisierungsfunktionen der Werbeplattformen auf ihren Mehrwert. Tracking-Setup & Datensicherheit: Du implementierst und verwaltest Tracking-Setups (z. B. Conversion-APIs, UTM-Konventionen) und stellst eine saubere, datenschutzkonforme Datengrundlage sicher. Testing: Du verantwortest fortlaufende A/B-Tests und Budget-Experimente zur kontinuierlichen Performance-Steigerung aller Kanäle. Partner-Management & Kollaboration: Du verhandelst und entwickelst Vendor- und Partnerverträge (z. B. im Affiliate-Bereich) weiter. Bei der Kampagnenabstimmung arbeitest du eng mit den Teams aus Design, Content und IT zusammen. Mentoring: Du unterstützt bei der fachlichen Anleitung sowie dem Onboarding von Junior-Kolleg*innen im Team und teilst dein KI-Wissen. Dein Profil Ausbildung: Du hast dein Studium (BWL, Marketing, Medien, Kommunikationswissenschaften o. Ä.) erfolgreich abgeschlossen oder bringst eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit. Relevante Berufserfahrung: Du bringst mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Performance Marketing mit – idealerweise kanalübergreifend (SEA, Paid Social, Affiliate) und mit nachweisbarer Budget- oder Teilprojektverantwortung. Erste Erfahrung in der fachlichen Führung ist von Vorteil. AI-Expertise (Must-have): Du besitzt praxiserprobte Erfahrung im Einsatz von KI-Tools und LLMs im Marketing-Kontext (z. B. Prompting für Reporting, Analysen, Forecasting). Du verfolgst aktuelle AI-Trends aktiv und brennst darauf, diese bei benuta einzubringen. Hard Skills: Du zeichnest dich durch ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten aus, nutzt GA4 sowie gängige Attributions-/Reporting-Tools souverän und hast tiefe Kenntnisse in mindestens einem Zentralkanal (Google Ads, Meta). Erfahrung mit Bing, Pinterest, Reddit, Affiliate und serverseitigem Tracking runden dein Profil ab. Soft Skills: Du arbeitest datengetrieben, denkst lösungsorientiert und begeisterst dich für E-Commerce sowie die Themen Home & Living. Sprachkompetenz: Deine Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sind sehr gut (weitere Sprachen sind ein Plus). Deine Benefits Impact & Gestaltungsspielraum : Bei uns kannst du aktiv mitgestalten, die Marke benuta weiterentwickeln und spannende KI-Projekte umsetzen – wie etwa den Aufbau KI-gestützter Analyse-Workflows für unsere Kampagnendaten. Deine Ideen werden gehört und du bekommst Freiraum für die Umsetzung eigener Ansätze. Präsenz & Flexibilität: Der Schwerpunkt unserer Arbeit liegt auf dem persönlichen Austausch und der gemeinsamen Zusammenarbeit vor Ort an unserem Standort in Berlin. Für die nötige Flexibilität in deiner Alltagsplanung - sei es für private Termine oder ungestörtes Arbeiten - bieten wir dir ein jährliches Kontingent von 26 Home-Office-Tagen. Deine Mobilität: Egal wie du zu uns kommst, wir unterstützen dich. Du hast die Wahl zwischen einem vergünstigten Jobticket oder einer Tankkarte. Zudem bieten wir dir ein Firmenrad-Leasing (JobRad) und eine gute ÖPNV-Anbindung. Zeit für Erholung: Du erhältst 28 Tage Urlaub und profitierst von unserem flexiblen Gleitzeitmodell. Weihnachten und Silvester sind bei uns grundsätzlich arbeitsfreie Tage, die nicht von deinem Urlaubskonto abgehen. Deine Entwicklung: Unsere unterschiedlichen Abteilungen mit internationalen Teams arbeiten an vielfältigen Projekten zusammen. Dadurch lernst Du permanent neue Sichtweisen, Tools und Prozesse kennen – inklusive aktuellster KI-Anwendungen im Performance Marketing. Kultur & Mitarbeitervorteile: Ein strukturiertes Onboarding, flache Hierarchien und attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte warten auf dich. raw.title: Cloud Engineer - Quantum Computing (m/w/d)
raw.description:
eleQtron develops and operates full-stack quantum computers based on trapped-ion technology. Quantum computing is a new computing paradigm rapidly approaching commercial viability. Our unique approach combines laser-cooled trapped ions with microwave control and tailored magnetic fields. Our next-generation computing machines under development will be able to find solutions to problems that are out of reach today, thus enabling new innovative products and services for a brighter future.

We are looking for a Cloud Engineer (m/f/d) to join us in Hamburg or Siegen and build and operate the scalable, secure cloud platform that connects users with our trapped-ion quantum computers.

Responsibilities:

You will join our Quantum firmware Team as a Cloud Engineer. You will build the layer through which the world reaches our quantum computers. Users submit quantum programs; your services compile, schedule, and dispatch them to our machines and return the results:  

  • Build and operate the cloud services that let users submit quantum programs to our systems and retrieve their results.

  • Develop and deploy our compilation pipeline as a scalable cloud service , from circuit input through transpilation down to hardware-level instructions

  • Design and maintain the public API and SDK entry points to our platform 

  • Implement job queuing, scheduling, and dispatch towards the hardware backends, including quota, prioritisation, and result handling 

  • Own authentication and authorisation across the platform: user and tenant identity, API keys and tokens, and role-based access to machines, jobs, and results, built on an established identity provider rather than from scratch

  • Guarantee tenant isolation, so that quantum programs and results are never visible across customer boundaries, and manage secrets and credentials across the stack

  • Work with the quantum firmware and hardware teams on the interfaces between cloud services and the machine itself

  • Instrument the platform for observability and keep an eye on latency, throughput, and cost


Required Skills:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying backend or platform services in production

  • Strong Python; additional systems-level language experience (Go, Rust, C++) is welcome

  • Solid API design skills (REST and/or gRPC) for services other developers have to use

  • Practical experience implementing authentication and authorisation in production systems: OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect, token handling, and role-based access control

  • Secure engineering habits: least privilege by default, proper secrets management, and awareness of dependency and container supply-chain risks

  • Infrastructure as code (Terraform, Pulumi, or similar) and CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or similar)

  • Working understanding of GDPR and data residency requirements, and a genuine interest in digital sovereignty

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with experimental physicists and engineers

  • Strong adaptability and a quick learning mindset

  • Good proficiency in English (written and spoken); German is an advantage for working with public-sector partners

Nice to have (Bonus)

  • Running an identity provider in production (Keycloak, Zitadel, Ory, Authentik, or a managed IAM service)

  • Multi-tenant isolation patterns in SaaS platforms

  • Contributing to security certification work (ISO 27001, BSI IT-Grundschutz, BSI C5) or acting on penetration test findings

  • Familiarity with quantum SDKs and toolchains (Qiskit, Cirq, PennyLane, QIR) or hardware abstraction interfaces such as QDMI

  • Batch scheduling or HPC environments (Slurm or similar)

  • Observability stacks such as Prometheus, Grafana, or OpenTelemetry

  • Prior exposure to quantum computing or other deep-tech domains

Based on sample insights, you analyze gaps, identify improvement opportunities, and directly translate these into optimized trainings and processes. You're the bridge between operations and quality assurance - with a focus on measurable results and continuous improvement.

You work internationally with teams across different markets, expanding our documentation and training materials to new European markets.

Ready to join us? We'd love to see your application!


Your Responsibilities:

  • Training Design, Delivery & Quality Improvement: You develop, implement, and optimize trainings and learning paths. Through regular sample analyses conducted by the team, you identify gaps and directly translate improvements into new trainings
  • Process documentation & expansion: You document, update, and expand our process documentation to additional European markets (such as the UK)
  • Knowledge management: You build and structure a knowledge database that serves as a foundation for AI-powered tools and support the quality management department in AI-driven processes
  • Data-driven optimization: You leverage our KPI reporting for continuous improvement of our quality standards
  • International collaboration: You work cross-functionally with teams across other entities and squads to anchor processes and documentation locally


What we're looking for:

Must-Haves

  • Experience: Minimum 3+ years at senior level in Training & Documentation and/or Quality Management
  • Languages: Fluent in English, German knowledge is beneficial 
  • Technical competence: Experience with Learning Management Systems or learning path design; familiarity with process documentation and process optimization
  • Industry knowledge: Strong understanding of internationally varying regulatory requirements, ideally in Collections and/or Data Protection
  • AI tools: Basic understanding of AI-powered tools such as Claude and their practical application
  • Soft skills: Independent, structured work style with ownership mentality and strong written and verbal communication skills
Nice-to-Haves
  • Experience in the collections industry or other heavily regulated sectors (Legal, Finance, Compliance)
  • Knowledge of another European language
  • Experience with Debt Collection in the UK and applicable regulatory requirements
  • Familiarity with SharePoint and the Microsoft 365 ecosystem
  • Experience with Instructional Design (ID) Frameworks, Content Management, or Knowledge Engineering

Our Values
At PAIR Finance, customer-centricity, transparency, and integrity are at the heart of everything we do - and every team member lives these values. We're also driven by innovation and the ambition to actively shape what we do. Do you see yourself reflected in these values? We'd love to meet you!


Our offer for you:

Work Environment

  • Hybrid work model with 2-3 days on-site per week at our modern office in Berlin-Charlottenburg
  • You'll work alongside professional colleagues and experts from over 30 nationalities
  • Your colleagues will support you from day one with advice and practical help, ensuring a warm welcome
  • Transparent feedback & annual development conversations, monthly all-hands meetings, and flat hierarchies
Benefits
  • Permanent employment contract, flexible working hours, and 28 vacation days
  • For this senior position, our salary band is €47,000 - €57,000 per year (based on a 40-hour week). The exact offer depends on your experience and qualifications. We're also open to strong mid-level candidates - in that case, the salary would be below this range
  • Subsidy for Germany ticket plus access to corporate benefits
  • Annual summer and winter parties in Berlin, plus regular team events
Career & Development
  • Challenging, diverse tasks that fuel your steep learning curve
  • Individual training budget and language courses

    We get to know you, your motivation and background, and you'll get first insights into PAIR Finance and the role.

    We'll dive deeper into your experience and the position. This is your chance to learn more about the tasks, challenges, and the team.

    We'll conduct a case study during this conversation. Please plan for approximately 1–2 hours of preparation time. We'll assess your functional knowledge, discuss collaboration with internal stakeholders and within the team.
